_source: EHS Tour Guide Handout for building/room data; Google Maps satellite imagery (orientation verified by the on-map compass needle, north = up) for the cardinal positions and campus boundaries below. No official building-position map image has been published yet.

campus_context.orientation: North is up (standard Google Maps orientation, verified by the on-map compass needle).

boundary_streets.north: Central Parkway — the campus faces north onto Central Pkwy and the main driveway entrance is on this side.
boundary_streets.west: Chancery Lane (with Brannigan Street parallel further west).
boundary_streets.east: Grafton Street (with Fitzwilliam Street parallel further east).
boundary_streets.south: The campus Athletic Field forms the south edge; Devany Square park sits just off the southwest corner, and the Dublin Boulevard arterial runs further south.

zones.north: Academic cluster — Administration (Building A) and the other academic buildings (C, D, E, F, G) sit in the north and central portion of the campus, visible from Central Parkway.
zones.south: Athletics cluster — the Gym (Building M), Locker Rooms (Building L), and the Stadium (athletic field with 8-lane track) occupy the south portion of campus.

A.name: Administration (Building A)
A.position: North side of campus, fronting Central Parkway. The main driveway entrance from Central Pkwy drops visitors right at Building A.
A.notes: Two floors. Floor 1 houses the Administration Offices, Health Center, and Staff Lounge. Floor 2 has the Wellness Center, Counselor Offices, and Student Services Offices.

C.name: Visual & Performing Arts (Building C)
C.notes: Band, Choir, and Theatre Arts classrooms; Ceramics & Sculpture and Visual Arts studios. A Phase 2 expansion (completed July 2025) added a Dance Studio, Video Production Studio, and Theater Make-up & Locker Room.

D.name: Student Union (Building D)
D.notes: Climate-controlled indoor–outdoor flexible gathering space. Houses the ASB Activities Center, Food Court, and a 150-seat Lecture Hall. The Catherine C. Kuo Performing Arts Center is planned as part of the Phase 3 expansion here.

E.name: Library / ACCESS Center (Building E)
E.notes: Two floors. Floor 1: Library and Media & Technology Center. Floor 2: Academic College & Career Education Student Support (ACCESS) Center.

F.name: Academic Tower 1 (Building F)
F.notes: Three floors; 36 academic classrooms including 2 computer labs, 4 chemistry labs, and 6 science flex labs, all accessible via 4 staircases and an elevator. Also houses the Special Education Offices and 2 Special Education Lifeskills rooms. The main vestibule has showcase cabinets and provides north–south access from the Main Courtyard to Academic Tower 2 (Building G). Restrooms on every floor; a 2nd-floor Walking Bridge to Academic Tower 2 is part of Phase 2.

G.name: Academic Tower 2 (Building G)
G.notes: Second academic tower, completed July 2025. Linked to Academic Tower 1 (Building F) by the 2nd-floor Walking Bridge.

L.name: Locker Rooms (Building L)
L.position: South side of campus, part of the athletics cluster next to the Gym (Building M) and the Stadium.
L.notes: Girls and Boys locker rooms, Kinesiology Lab, and Weight Room.

M.name: Gymnasium (Building M)
M.position: South side of campus, between the academic buildings to the north and the Stadium to the south; adjacent to the Locker Rooms (Building L).
M.notes: 2,400-seat bleacher gym with 3 basketball courts and 9 volleyball/badminton courts. Also contains the PE Fitness Classroom.

Administration Office.position: North side of campus; the main driveway from Central Parkway drops visitors right at the Building A entrance.
Administration Office.description: Main administration office — first stop for visitors, phones, and front-desk questions.

Health Center.description: On-campus Health Center for medical issues during the school day.

Staff Lounge.description: Staff lounge, Building A floor 1 (staff only).

Wellness Center.description: Mental-health and wellness support space, 2nd floor of Building A alongside the counselor offices.

Counselor Offices.description: Academic / college counselors' offices on the 2nd floor of Building A. For which counselor a specific student is assigned to, use lookup_counselor_by_last_name.

Student Services.description: Student Services offices (registrar, records, etc.), 2nd floor of Building A.

Library.description: School library and Media & Technology Center, 1st floor of Building E.

Media & Technology Center.description: Shares the 1st floor of Building E with the Library.

ACCESS Center.description: Academic College & Career Education Student Support (ACCESS) Center — academic help and college-prep resources, 2nd floor of Building E.

Food Court.description: Student dining area inside the Student Union (Building D).

ASB Activities Center.description: Associated Student Body activity office / events space inside the Student Union.

Lecture Hall.description: 150-seat lecture hall inside the Student Union.

Band Room.description: Band classroom in the Visual & Performing Arts building (Building C).

Choir Room.description: Choir classroom in the Visual & Performing Arts building (Building C).

Theatre Arts Room.description: Theatre Arts classroom in Building C.

Ceramics & Sculpture Studio.description: Ceramics & Sculpture studio in Building C.

Visual Arts Studio.description: Visual Arts studio in Building C.

Dance Studio.description: Dance studio added in the Phase 2 Building C expansion (July 2025).

Video Production Studio.description: Video Production studio added in the Phase 2 Building C expansion (July 2025).

Catherine C. Kuo Performing Arts Center.description: Performing Arts Center planned as part of the Phase 3 expansion inside the Student Union (Building D). Not yet open.

Chemistry Labs.description: Four chemistry labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F).

Science Flex Labs.description: Six science flex labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F).

Computer Labs.description: Two computer labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F).

Special Education Offices.description: Special Education offices and two Special Education Lifeskills rooms inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F).

Walking Bridge.description: A 2nd-floor covered walking bridge connecting Academic Tower 1 (Building F) and Academic Tower 2 (Building G). Part of the Phase 2 construction.

Girls Locker Room.description: Girls locker room in Building L.

Boys Locker Room.description: Boys locker room in Building L.

Gym.description: The main gymnasium: 2,400 bleacher seats, 3 basketball courts, 9 volleyball/badminton courts.

PE Fitness Classroom.description: PE Fitness classroom inside the Gymnasium (Building M).

Stadium.position: South end of campus; occupies the south edge of the parcel, inside the campus boundary and north of the Dublin Boulevard arterial.

Tennis Courts.description: Eight tennis courts near the Stadium and Academic Tower 2.

Main Courtyard.position: Central area of campus, between the Administration (Building A) area on the north and the Gym (Building M) / Stadium area on the south.
Main Courtyard.description: The central courtyard; Academic Tower 1 (Building F) opens off it, with north–south access through Building F's main vestibule to Academic Tower 2 (Building G).

Snack Bar.description: An exterior Snack Bar with adjacent restrooms.

navigation_notes: Cardinal orientation (confirmed from Google Maps satellite imagery with its on-map compass needle): north is up. The campus is bounded by Central Parkway on the north, Chancery Lane on the west, Grafton Street on the east, and the campus Athletic Field at the south (with Dublin Boulevard further south).
The main driveway entrance is on the north side off Central Parkway, dropping visitors right at the Administration (Building A) entrance.
Visitors should start at the Administration Office on the 1st floor of Building A.
The counselor offices, Wellness Center, and Student Services all share the 2nd floor of Building A.
The Library and ACCESS Center are both in Building E — Library on floor 1, ACCESS Center on floor 2.
The Food Court, ASB Activities Center, and 150-seat Lecture Hall are all inside the Student Union (Building D).

The two academic towers (Building F and Building G) are linked by a 2nd-floor Walking Bridge; the north–south path through Building F's main vestibule gets you between the Main Courtyard and Building G at ground level.
Athletics cluster together: Gym (Building M), Locker Rooms (Building L), Stadium (field + 8-lane track), and the 8 tennis courts.

This map data is sourced from the EHS Tour Guide Handout. If someone asks about a building or room that isn't listed here (for example a specific Building B that the handout doesn't describe), say the handout doesn't cover it and point them at the Administration Office at (925) 551-4040.

No official building-position map image has been published yet for Emerald (the campus is still in phased construction, with Phase 3 adding the Catherine C. Kuo Performing Arts Center). The cardinal zones (north = academic, south = athletics) and campus boundaries above are confirmed from Google Maps satellite imagery; the individual academic buildings (C, D, E, F, G) all sit in the north-and-center academic cluster, but their exact letter-to-footprint mapping isn't labeled on satellite imagery and hasn't been digitised here yet.
